items.title: Down 11.6% in 4 Weeks, Here's Why Ralph Lauren (RL) Looks Ripe for a Turnaround
items.summary: Ralph Lauren (RL) has become technically an oversold stock now, which implies exhaustion of the heavy selling pressure on it. This, combined with strong agreement among Wall Street analysts in revising earnings estimates higher, indicates a potential trend reversal for the stock in the near term.

items.title: Preppy Style Is Booming. What Does It Look Like Now?
items.summary: What started as a uniform of students on the campuses of elite schools has grown into a colorful, ever-expanding American style—one that over decades has been remixed in cities and beach towns, on runways and online.  Preppy style has also become hot again.  Ralph Lauren sales have climbed—especially in Asia—outperforming some European luxury giants.
